exposure: maternal pre-pregnancy BMI (obesity vs. normal weight)
cohort: Pregnant women with singleton pregnancies undergoing planned Caesarean delivery without labor at term, categorized as obese (BMI >=30 kg/m2) or normal weight (BMI <25 kg/m2).
finding: Maternal obesity was associated with reduced placental LC3B levels in the central region of the placenta and increased placental and fetal weight in uncomplicated term pregnancies.
cross-section timing: at term during planned Caesarean delivery
birth_weight: Fetal weight was measured as an outcome, but no specific inclusion range for birth weight was mentioned.
